exceptions.name: REPORT · LAGOON HEALTH · PROJECT MONEY
exceptions.reason: Conflicts 1: E-PROJECT and E-REPORT carry no eyebrow; the frontend composes no title. The project title stays the page heading and the report title is the Money panel's h2 (D-104).
Conflicts 5: PAID for paid.status not_due shows the board's dash with the visually hidden words "Not due", so the cell's text is "—Not due"; an absent paid object reads Unknown, never a dash.

exceptions.name: Not yet due · amount set at go-live
